hypothesis: On a completed bar, MACD(12,26) crosses from <=0 to >0 with RSI(14)>50; next-bar-open long entries can beat equal-capital buy-and-hold after fees, slippage, and funding.
market: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual historical simulation; no live orders

code.indicator_hash_note: The source and research-worktree indicator files differ only by additional unused functions (confirmed by diff); the four functions used here match.

risk.position_policy: one open position per symbol and strategy, fixed 1x notional per equal symbol sleeve, no pyramiding

selection_policy: Frozen in plan.md: validation must beat matched B&H net CAGR, positive average net trade, >=30 trades, and no higher MDD; select max validation CAGR per timeframe, ties by lower turnover then fixed policy order; final holdout is evaluated once only for selected policies.
multiple_testing: 7-day moving-block bootstrap; Holm across up to 12 selected final timeframe tests

agents.limitation: Agent shells could not access the repository; output is design caution only, not independent source verification. Lead performed local source review.

execution_amendment.funding_mark_proxy: for blank markPrice only, most recent prior 1m candle open; timestamp age must be under 60 seconds
execution_amendment.proxy_caveat: approximate exchange mark; report missing-mark count and qualify funding-adjusted metrics
